battle.name: 奉天之戰
battle.brief: 建中四年（783）十月涇原兵變，朱泚據長安稱帝，德宗出奔奉天。十一月叛軍大將姚令言率眾圍奉天，渭北行營使渾杼憑城固守，城中糧水俱竭、士卒掘地取水。卡面的羅馬弩砲未曾到過奉天，但它一發一具、靠扭力蓄能的投射邏輯，正對應唐廷的弩砲、床弩與拋石機。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 奉天之戰是建中四年（783）十月涇原兵變之後，唐廷與朱泚在關中乾縣奉天城下的一場攻防。叛軍一方的主體是涇原鎮兵：涇原節度使姚令言率兵入京，事變之後，朱泚在建號大燕、自立為帝，把涇原降卒與京師降附的禁軍混編成攻奉天的圍城軍，由姚令言總攏其兵，屯營於奉天西北，一面造攻城器械、掘地道，一面斷絕關中往來的道路。守城一方是唐廷匆忙拼湊出來的殘軍與州縣武裝：渭北行營使渾杼奉詔守奉天，麾下有北衙禁軍散卒、奉天及鄰近各縣的團練、隨駕護衛，以及關中諸鎮遣來的第一批援兵，數量既少，糧秣也不繼。援軍主力來自河中節度使李懷光與邠寧節度使韓遊瓌；另有劍南西川節度使韋皋在蜀中拒絕朱泚的調兵命令，朔方、隴右、關內各道亦陸續起兵勤王。兩造體制的根本差別在指揮與補給：叛軍以姚令言的涇原兵為骨幹，軍令單一、糧食就地徵發，卻受制於長安方面的朱泚朝廷；唐廷有詔令與節度使的名分，卻只能靠各鎮自備兵糧、自行發遣，一紙勤王詔書往往要數十日才化為開到城下的部隊。
countriesEn: The Battle of Fengtian was a siege fought after the Jingyuan mutiny of October 783 (the fourth year of Jianzhong), between the Tang court and the forces of Zhu Ci over the walls of Fengtian, in Qian County in the heart of Guanzhong. On the rebel side the backbone was the Jingyuan circuit army: Yao Lingyan, the Jingyuan jiedushi, had marched his troops into the capital, and after the mutiny broke out, Zhu Ci, who proclaimed the state of Great Yan and took the imperial title, merged the surrendered Jingyuan soldiers with the palace guards who capitulated in the capital into a besieging army for Fengtian. Yao Lingyan held overall command, his camps lying north-west of the city, where his men built siege engines, drove tunnels, and cut the roads that linked Guanzhong with the rest of the empire. The defenders were whatever the Tang court could scrape together in haste, regulars and local militia together: Hun Zhu, commander of the Weibei field army, was ordered to hold Fengtian, and under him were scattered men of the Northern Palace Guard, the local militia of Fengtian and of the neighbouring counties, the escort that had followed the emperor, and the first detachments sent by the circuits of Guanzhong. Their numbers were small and their supplies unmaintained. The main relief came from the Hedong jiedushi Li Huaiguang of Hezhong and from Han Youguan of Binning; elsewhere the Xichuan jiedushi Wei Gao refused in Sichuan to obey Zhu Ci's summons, and the circuits of Shuofang, Longyou and Guannei raised troops to勤王 in turn. The decisive difference between the two systems lay in command and supply: the rebels had Yao Lingyan's Jingyuan soldiers as their backbone, a single chain of orders, and food requisitioned on the spot, yet they remained dependent on Zhu Ci's government at Chang'an; the Tang court had edicts and the authority of the jiedushi, but it could only rely on each circuit to equip and dispatch its own men, so a single call for help often took dozens of days to become troops actually fighting below the walls.
people: 奉天城下的關鍵人物分屬兩營。叛軍方面，涇原節度使姚令言是兵變的直接發動者，也是圍城的統帥，攻城與掘道的決策多出其手。朱泚則是涇原出身的前節度使，兵變中被裹挾而出，隨即在建中四年十月於長安含元殿即位，國號大燕，年號諸說並存，或作應天，他把前節度使的資歷與人望轉化為叛軍的合法性招牌。守城與勤王方面，渭北行營使渾杼是奉天城最堅實的支柱，靠殘兵與州縣武裝頂住姚令言的連日強攻；河中節度使李懷光領河中兵西援，是解圍的關鍵，旗下名將李晟隨軍出發，後來在興元元年率軍收復長安，成為平叛的真正主力；邠寧節度使韓遊瓌自西北方向接應，劍南西川節度使韋皋在成都拒絕朱泚的調兵命令，保住劍南不入叛軍之手。朝廷文臣之中，行軍參謀陸贄在奉天、鳳翔之間起草指斥朱泚的檄文與詔令，是這場戰爭裡文字上的另一條戰線。德宗李適本人則是城中的核心，也是最沉重的象徵：出奔時百餘人相隨，圍城數十日，糧盡水濁，與將士同食糲，靠這份艱苦撐到援兵到來。
peopleEn: The decisive figures at Fengtian fall into two camps. On the rebel side, Yao Lingyan, the Jingyuan jiedushi, was the man who set the mutiny in motion and also the commander of the siege; the decisions on assault and tunnelling were largely his. Zhu Ci was the former jiedushi native to Jingyuan, swept along by the mutiny and then, in the tenth month of Jianzhong, enthroned himself in the Hall of Contained Origin at Chang'an under the state name of Great Yan, his era name recorded variously but most often as Yingtian; he turned the standing and prestige of a former jiedushi into the rebels' claim to legitimacy. On the defending and relief side, Hun Zhu, commander of the Weibei field army, was the firmest pillar of Fengtian, holding the city against Yao Lingyan's repeated assaults with a handful of regulars and county militia. Li Huaiguang, jiedushi of Hezhong, led the Hedong troops west to the relief and was the key to the lifting of the siege; the noted general Li Sheng went out with him and would in the first year of Xingyuan lead the army that retook Chang'an, becoming in truth the commander who ended the rebellion. Han Youguan, jiedushi of Binning, brought support in from the north-west, while Wei Gao, jiedushi of Xichuan, refused in Chengdu to obey Zhu Ci's summons, keeping Sichuan out of the rebel camp. Among the civil officials, Lü Zhi, the military reference secretary, drafted between Fengtian and Fengxiang the proclamations and edicts branding Zhu Ci a criminal, a second front of the war fought on paper. The emperor Dezong, Li Shi, was himself the pivot of the city and its heaviest symbol: a hundred-odd men had followed him in his flight, and during the dozens of days of siege, with grain spent and the water foul, he ate the same coarse husks as his soldiers, and it was on that endurance that the city held until relief came.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬弩砲不會出現在奉天城下：Scorpio 是公元前50年前後羅馬人使用的扭力投射器，一發一具箭，靠絞合的皮筋蓄能，把一支沉重的箭矢推出，維特魯威在《建築十書》裡描述過它，幅廣約十二肘、高約三肘、扭力臂長約四、五肘，操作須數人分工，裝填一次、射擊一次。奉天攻防中真正上陣的，是同一類投射邏輯在唐代的版本：以床弩、弩砲這類機括弩居高臨下壓制攻隊，以蹶張弩發射重箭，射速雖慢而單箭足以穿甲破盾；拋石機以配重甩擲石彈，射程遠而精度差，專打城頭、樓堞與密集隊列。守方另有檑木與撞杆，用來擊砸敵方的撞車，猛火油與火球則對付貼上城牆的雲梯與巢車；攻方造雲梯、填壕溝，並試圖掘地道穿牆而入。糧秣與軍器由輜重隊、牛車與驢隊分揀，循涇水、渭水北段與洛水通道運往關中各堡寨，沿途許多物資被叛軍游騎截斷，人畜俱損。
kitsEn: The Roman scorpio on the card face would not have appeared below the walls of Fengtian. The Scorpio was a torsion engine in use among the Romans around 50 BC: one heavy bolt to a shot, the energy stored in twisted skinned cords that hurled the bolt out with enormous force, described by Vitruvius in the De architectura as about twelve cubits wide, three cubits high, with torsion arms of four or five cubits, worked by several men, reloaded and fired one shot at a time. What actually fought at Fengtian was the same logic in a Tang version. Bed crossbows and fixed bolt-throwers on frames, the qiang nu pao, dominated the defenders from the wallheads, while the draw-heavy crossbows of the Qizhang nu loosed heavy bolts, slow to shoot but able to pierce armour and shield; counterweight trebuchets flung stones, accurate only in the crudest sense but reaching far enough to smash wallheads, battlements and packed formations. On the defender's side were logs and beams for smashing attackers' battering rams, and quicklime-oil and fire-pots against scaling ladders and siege towers that had reached the wall; on the attacker's side were scaling ladders, filled ditches and attempts to drive tunnels through the masonry. Grain and ordnance were sorted by baggage trains, ox-carts and mule teams moving along the Jing, the northern Wei and the Luo corridors to the fortified posts of Guanzhong, and much of it was cut off on the road by rebel mounted patrols, losing both men and animals.
tactics: 奉天攻防的形態是典型的圍城與反圍城。姚令言的軍隊抵達之後不急於強攻，先以拋石機與弓弩掃清城頭、封鎖四面道路，再分批驅使攻城部隊填壕、登梯，同時日夜掘地道，試圖在牆根下掏空城基。守軍以床弩與礫石機壓制梯隊，把攀城者逼退，並以反挖地道與火攻燒毀攻方器械；城內糧水兩絕之後，守軍轉入被圍狀態，士卒採草掘土取水，帝亦與眾同食糲。真正的戰局轉折在援軍抵達：河中與邠寧的援軍不約而至，叛軍回頭迎戰，唐軍乘勢以精騎夜襲營壘，圍城遂解。德宗隨即移駕鳳翔，把重心再退一步以縮短補給線，同時詔令各道出兵。此後的戰略從守城轉為收復關中，李晟所部在關中東南一線集結，待朱泚主力西撤之後直趨長安，逼其正面迎戰。
tacticsEn: The shape of the fighting at Fengtian was that of a classic siege and counter-siege. Once Yao Lingyan's army was in position it did not rush the walls: trebuchets and volleys of arrows first swept the parapets and sealed the roads on all four sides, then assault detachments were fed in by batches to fill the ditches and climb the ladders, while tunnelling went on day and night in an attempt to hollow out the foundations beneath the walls. The defenders used bed crossbows and stone-throwers to break up the escalade and drive the climbers back, counter-mined against the galleries, and burned the attackers' engines with fire; once food and water had both failed inside, the garrison went over to a state of blockade, the men foraging for grass and digging for water, and the emperor ate the same coarse husks as they did. The real turn in the battle came with the arrival of relief: the troops of Hezhong and Binning closed in, the rebels turned to meet them, and the Tang cavalry struck the rebel camp by night, and the siege was lifted. Dezong then moved the court on to Fengxiang, retreating a further step to shorten the supply line while issuing fresh calls for aid to every circuit. From then on the strategy shifted from holding a city to retaking Guanzhong: Li Sheng's troops mustered along the south-eastern approaches to the basin and, once Zhu Ci's main force had been drawn west, marched straight for Chang'an, forcing the rebels to face them in the open.
data: 可核對的數字有限，逐一列出。兵變的基本兵力是五千：《資治通鑑》記姚令言將兵五千自涇原至京師，別有說法作四千上下，這支部隊是往後圍奉天大軍的骨幹。涇原軍營至長安的行程約五百公里，沒有水運可借，全靠步行，走了數日。奉天距長安直線約七十公里，沿扶風、武功的道路迂回約一百一十公里；河中治所蒲州至奉天約四百公里，援軍要十日上下才趕得到城下，這就是「援兵不至」的真實尺度。圍城歷時數十日，其間奉天井水混濁、軍食告罄，掘地取水、以草根充飢，帝與將士同食糲。朱泚自建中四年十月在長安即位，至興元元年十月在奉天被殺，在位不足一年；大燕佔據京師約十個月，興元元年九月李晟收復長安。朱泚西走奉天時，段秀實出戰，以鐵錘擊中朱泚，叛軍隨即崩潰。卡面那具羅馬弩砲的年代是公元前50年上下，比這一場戰爭早八百三十三年；維特魯威所記的尺寸折合約寬五米餘、高二米有奇，須數人操作，裝填一次射擊一次，與唐廷的機括弩在運作邏輯上同屬一類，只是蓄能方式一為扭力、一為機括。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and they are best set out one by one. The mutiny's basic force was five thousand men: the Zizhi Tongjian records that Yao Lingyan brought five thousand soldiers from Jingyuan to the capital, while other accounts put the number nearer four thousand; that body of men became the backbone of the army that later besieged Fengtian. The march from the Jingyuan garrison to Chang'an was about five hundred kilometres, with no water transport available, the men walking it in several days. Fengtian lies about seventy kilometres from Chang'an in a straight line, some hundred and ten by the winding road through Fufeng and Wugong; from the seat of Hezhong at Puzhou to Fengtian is roughly four hundred kilometres, so a relief army needed something like ten days on the march to reach the walls, and that is the true measure behind the chronic complaint that help never came. The siege ran for dozens of days; within it the wells of Fengtian turned foul and the military food ran out, the garrison dug for water and ate grass roots, and the emperor shared the coarse husks with his soldiers. Zhu Ci had enthroned himself at Chang'an in the tenth month of Jianzhong and was killed at Fengtian in the tenth month of the first year of Xingyuan, so his reign lasted under a year; Great Yan held the capital for some ten months until Li Sheng retook Chang'an in the ninth month of that year. When Zhu Ci fled west to Fengtian, Duan Xiushi went out to meet him and struck him with an iron hammer, and the rebel army collapsed at once. The Roman scorpio on the card dates from around 50 BC, roughly eight hundred and thirty-three years before this battle; the dimensions Vitruvius gives work out to a little over five metres wide and a little over two metres high, needing several men to work, one shot per loading, and in its operating logic it belongs to the same family as the Tang mechanism crossbows, the difference being that one stores its power in twisted skinned cord and the other in a ratcheted trigger mechanism.
cause: 起因要從建中年間的削藩說起。德宗即位以來裁諸道節度使兼領州刺史之權、停罷進奉、加行兩稅，關中邊鎮首當其衝，涇原尤為吃力：軍額既裁，士卒久欠糧餉，又久戍苦寒。建中四年十月，朝廷命涇原出兵入衛，兵至京師而犒賞未備、宿置無所，姚令言約束不住，軍中遂譁變，劫持朝儀，迎朱泚為主。朱泚既入城，即收兵權、清宮禁，誅殺宿將與宦官數十人，搜括府庫，逼百官僭號，數日之間由節度使而為大燕皇帝，德宗被迫出奔奉天。朝廷倉促之間發出的勤王詔書，反倒成了各鎮擴兵、固地盤的契機：藩鎮出兵是為自保，觀望才是常態，李懷光、韓遊瓌、韋皋肯來，說明援軍並非為朝廷，而是為各自的處境。
causeEn: The origins have to be traced to the reduction of the provincial military governors during the Jianzhong era. Since his accession Dezong had stripped the jiedushi of the right to hold the prefectures they governed, stopped the tribute of the best produce, and imposed the two-tax system, and the circuits of Guanzhong bore the brunt of this, Jingyuan above all: its troop establishment was cut, its men had long gone without pay and rations, and they had served long years in bitter cold. In the tenth month of Jianzhong the court ordered the Jingyuan troops into the capital for guard duty; they arrived with no rewards ready and nowhere to quarter, Yao Lingyan could no longer hold them, and the soldiers mutinied, seized the court ceremonial, and brought Zhu Ci forward as their leader. Once inside the city Zhu Ci gathered the military authority in his own hands, cleared the palace, put the senior generals and eunuchs to the sword to the number of several dozen, stripped the treasuries, and forced the assembled officials to adopt a foreign title; in a matter of days he had gone from jiedushi to emperor of Great Yan, and Dezong was driven out to Fengtian. The hurried calls for aid that the court now issued turned, ironically, into the opportunity for the circuits to enlarge their armies and entrench their own domains: the provincial troops came because of their own survival, and the default was to wait and see. The fact that Li Huaiguang, Han Youguan and Wei Gao did come shows that the relief was not sent for the Tang court but for their own situation.
impact: 奉天之難以一場叛亂的徹底失敗與一套制度的轉折收場。就戰事而言，德宗未被俘，朱泚大燕僅據長安一座城，圍攻奉天不成之後再無外線進展，涇原降卒中亦有人反水倒戈，最終在奉天被段秀實擊殺，叛軍集團崩解。就唐代政治而言，此役之後削藩的氣勢明顯收縮，藩鎮節度使在各自地盤的軍政財權更難被朝廷收回，藩鎮割據的格局由此鞏固，中唐轉入以兩稅與鹽利支撐的財政體系，重斂的同時也把負擔轉嫁到州縣與農戶身上。制度層面的變化更為長久：平亂之後禁軍宿衛的控制權更向宦官傾斜，奉天與鳳翔的護駕經驗，使朝廷更看重貼身之兵而輕外鎮之兵；奉天與鳳翔兩處堡寨因圍城而加築城防、儲備軍器，成為關中防禦體系上的新環節。經此一役，『奉天之難』四字成為唐代避亂播遷的代名詞，凡朝廷播遷、諸鎮觀望，皆以此為比。
impactEn: The Fengtian disaster closed with the total failure of the rebellion and a turning point in the institutions of the dynasty. In military terms Dezong was not captured; Zhu Ci's Great Yan held nothing but the city of Chang'an, and after failing at Fengtian it made no further progress on any outer front, some of the surrendered Jingyuan soldiers even turned against their own side, and in the end Zhu Ci was struck down by Duan Xiushi at Fengtian and the rebel group came apart. In the politics of the Tang, the momentum of the reduction of the governors visibly ebbed after this campaign: the military, administrative and fiscal powers the jiedushi held in their own territories were even harder for the court to recover, and the pattern of provincial separatism was thereby entrenched, the middle Tang settling into a fiscal system resting on the two-tax and the salt monopoly, with heavier exactions passed down at the same time onto the prefectures and the peasantry. The institutional change ran even longer. After the pacification the control of the palace guard tilted further towards the eunuchs, and the experience of being escorted and besieged at Fengtian and Fengxiang taught the court to trust the troops close at hand rather than those of the outer circuits. Both Fengtian and Fengxiang, having stood a siege, were reinforced with stronger walls and stored ordnance, becoming new links in the defensive system of Guanzhong. After this campaign the four characters Fengtian zhi nan became a byword in the Tang for flight and dispersal; whenever the court moved or the circuits hesitated, the comparison was drawn.
result: 奉天城沒有陷落。姚令言的圍城軍在唐廷援軍到達前後失去主動，攻城器械與地道所費甚多而城不能拔，守軍在糧水俱絕、井濁草根的處境下仍死守到援軍接應，圍城遂解，德宗得以移駕鳳翔，再圖關中。叛軍的崩解則延後一年：興元元年李晟收復長安，朱泚西走奉天，段秀實陣前擊中朱泚，叛軍當場潰散，朱泚死於亂軍，餘眾或降或散，涇原降卒重新編入唐軍，『大燕』這個國號只存在了不到一年。戰後清算的是人而非制度：姚令言被殺，叛軍首領與裹挾者分等處置，而削藩之策與藩鎮之勢都沒有因此逆轉。朝廷得到的只是一場平叛的勝利，和一個比戰前更難駕馭的天下。
resultEn: Fengtian did not fall. The besieging army of Yao Lingyan lost the initiative as Tang relief closed in; the siege engines and the galleries had cost dearly and the walls were not taken, and the garrison, reduced to foul water and grass roots, held on until the relief made contact, so the siege was lifted and Dezong was able to move the court on to Fengxiang and to plan afresh for Guanzhong. The rebel collapse came a year later: in the first year of Xingyuan Li Sheng retook Chang'an, Zhu Ci fled west to Fengtian, Duan Xiushi struck him in the battle line, the rebel army broke at once and Zhu Ci was killed in the disorder, survivors surrendering or scattering, the surrendered Jingyuan soldiers being re-enrolled in the Tang army, and the state name of Great Yan surviving for less than a year. What was settled afterwards were men, not institutions: Yao Lingyan was killed, the rebel leaders and those swept along with them were dealt with by rank, but neither the policy of reducing the governors nor the power of the governors was turned back. What the court had won was a victory over the rebellion and a realm harder to manage than before the war.
